item.title: Foul play suspected in officers death
item.description: Police Commissioner Rusiate Tudravu today confirmed elements of foul play in the death of a young police officer in Lami over the weekend. Tudravu made the confirmation during a press conference. He said that following the post-mortem examination of the late Constable Peni Racagi, the findings indicated elements of foul play.
